title: Agbara Nla
description: A village under the influence of Isawuru, a powerful herbalist, becomes the setting for a confrontation between spiritual oppression and a young couple carrying a Christian mission.
posterSource: Premium Times / official Agbara Nla: The Return artwork

title: The Ultimate Power
description: The English-language presentation of the Agbara Nla story, continuing Mount Zion's early Christian cinema tradition.
posterSource: Nairaland / Mount Zion Films poster archive reproduction

title: The Perilous Times
description: A vibrant deacon's choices threaten his marriage and ministry, leading to a spiritual crisis and a battle for restoration.

title: The Covenant Child
description: After making a covenant with God concerning her child, Eniola struggles when her son Samuel grows toward missionary work.

title: The Storms of Life
description: A family crisis caused by infidelity and neglect forces a couple to confront the consequences of choices made at home.

title: The Gods Are Dead
description: A missionary faces a confrontation with a priest after challenging the spiritual authority of the village gods.

title: Captives of the Mighty
description: A woman confronting repeated miscarriages turns to Jesus and, with her husband, confronts the spiritual conflict surrounding their marriage.

title: One Careless Night
description: A celebration after a new job leads to a chain of difficult consequences for a young couple and the people around them.

title: Esin Ajoji
description: A prince who has escaped an ancient curse brings the gospel back to Agbayun and confronts the spiritual powers of the land.

title: The Train
description: A film based on the true story of Mike Bamiloye and the journey that shaped his ministry and calling.
posterSource: Sinuola Blogs / Mount Zion Film Productions poster

title: Legion
description: An uplifting film about the highs and lows of youthful exuberance and the choices young people make.
posterSource: Graceful Journey by Design / Damilola Mike-Bamiloye poster

title: 30 Pieces
description: A thought-provoking Christian drama exploring repentance and forgiveness without relying on heavy-handed moralising.

title: Abejoye
description: An African traditionalist elder visiting his son in America becomes caught in conflicts between traditional beliefs and Pentecostal faith.

title: Where the River Divides
description: Inspired by a true story, a young man in 1979 Kenya returns home after baptism and must choose between his Christian faith and his father's traditional legacy.
posterSource: The EastAfrican / Where The River Divides poster
